name_vi: Túi trang sức du lịch dạng sách
description_en: A flat woven travel folio opening like a book, with empty fabric loops and zip pockets inside. Canonical front: a large woven cover with a short blank leather clasp. Side view: a fabric book spine and thin zipper edge. Rear view: a woven rear cover with a small wrist-loop attachment. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
